fast_preview.name: fast_preview
fast_preview.label: Fast Interactive Preview
fast_preview.target_tradeoff: Ultra-low latency (< 100 ms/frame) with balanced sensitivity for real-time scrub preview.

balanced.name: balanced
balanced.label: Balanced Production Master
balanced.target_tradeoff: Peak F1 trade-off between defect detection recall and false positive suppression.
balanced.evidence: Calibrated on dart_harness achieving maximum F1=0.6143 at threshold=0.80.

high_quality_precision.name: high_quality_precision
high_quality_precision.label: High Quality Precision (Face & Edge Safe)
high_quality_precision.target_tradeoff: Strict suppression of false positives on human faces, eyes, and high-contrast edges.
high_quality_precision.evidence: Calibrated on cnn_blotches at threshold=0.80 yielding Precision=0.8659.

high_recall.name: high_recall
high_recall.label: High Recall Defect Capture
high_recall.target_tradeoff: Maximizes recall to capture faint, translucent hairline scratches and micro-dust particles.
high_recall.evidence: Calibrated on dart_harness at threshold=0.50 yielding Recall=0.9697.

archival_preservation.name: archival_preservation
archival_preservation.label: Archival Preservation (Grain & Texture Safe)
archival_preservation.target_tradeoff: Conservative restoration strictly preserving photographic film grain and authentic archival texture.
archival_preservation.evidence: Calibrated on ridge at threshold=0.20 with Grain FPR <= 0.0000%.
